description: This file defines the PaymentMethod controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages the displaying and listing of payment methods for the customer's account, including handling authorization, preparing data for views, and loading external extensions.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class handling customer payment method display and listing

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that displays the payment method page, handles login validation redirection, and prepares view data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of payment methods with login validation.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs the list of available payment methods, including extension integrations.
